lessons: A market report's sector title is not evidence for a name until the cached peers in that sector moved with it. On 10-06 *healthcare heavyweights* rose. But the movers were the glove makers (+3.70% to +11.46%), on their own results, while the hospital peer KPJ fell 0.77%.
